descriptionHtml:
Intel Core i5-12400F Desktop Tray Processor 6 Cores 12 Threads up to 4.40 GHz

Optimize your custom desktop setup budget with the incredible value of the Intel Core i5-12400F Tray edition processor. Available at Turbo Computer, this high-performance PC hardware core component layout is shipped in standard tray packaging layout without a retail box or stock cooler, making it the absolute ideal choice for tech-savvy gamers, e-commerce store builders, and system integrators across Egypt who intend to deploy superior aftermarket air or liquid cooling thermal solutions. Built on Intel's 12th Gen Alder Lake architecture design, this CPU delivers great computational execution and solid everyday multi-app multitasking stability.

The Intel Core i5-12400F Tray version provides a highly efficient core layout featuring 6 dedicated Performance-cores (P-cores) and 12 processing threads to handle demanding applications smoothly. Operating at a 2.50 GHz base clock frequency that reaches a maximum turbo speed translation of 4.40 GHz via Intel Turbo Boost 2.0, it processes competitive gaming frames effortlessly. Backed by 18MB of responsive Intel Smart Cache, this flexible hardware platform provides dual-channel tracking matrix options supporting both standard DDR4 up to 3200MHz and next-generation DDR5 memory profiles up to 4800MHz speeds. Utilizing secure PCIe 5.0 and 4.0 data channels directly through the LGA1700 motherboard socket, this 'F' suffix variant features a 65W base power standard and strictly requires a discrete independent graphics card to handle display outputs. (Please Note: This is a Tray processor model; a separate aftermarket thermal cooling solution must be sourced for operational deployment).
